description: Source code for GuzzleHttp Client class implementing HTTP client functionalities, including request handling, asynchronous requests, configuration, and request option application.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: HTTP client class providing methods for sending HTTP requests, both synchronously and asynchronously, with configurable options and request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client with configuration options, setting default handler and base URI.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for HTTP methods, supporting async variants.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous HTTP request with given request object and options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a synchronous HTTP request by waiting for the async request to complete.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request following PSR-18 standard, with default options for redirects and errors.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP request.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Builds and resolves the request URI based on base URI and IDN options.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for the client, including proxy, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default options into request options before sending.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Transfers the request using the handler, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Applies request options to modify the request object accordingly.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Returns an exception for invalid body parameter usage.
